result.title: SplatWAM: Splatting World Action Models for Real-Time 3D Imagination
result.summary: World models typically predict future observations in pixel or latent space, limiting their ability to directly represent true 3D scene evolution. We present SplatWAM (Splatting World Action Model), a generative world model that learns action-conditioned dynamics directly over compact 3D Gaussian primitives. A tokenizer SplatWAM-T first encodes a variable number of unposed views into a fixed budget of Gaussian tokens. A dynamics model SplatWAM-D then predicts future Gaussian states in a single forward pass per action, using log-Euclidean covariance coordinates and differentiable rendering supervision to facilitate learning in an explicit 3D space. Each predicted state can be rasterized from arbitrary viewpoints, enforcing a shared 3D representation across views by construction. On OGBench Scene, SplatWAM renders novel views 12x faster than video world models (~80 FPS on an RTX 5090) with up to 2.0 dB higher PSNR. We further introduce SplatWAM-P, a lightweight flow-matching policy head jointly trained with the dynamics model. Across 8 task suites, model-free Gaussian-token policies outperform pixel-based counterparts by up to 24.8 percentage points. SplatWAM-P improves over Latent Particle World Model (LPWM) by 12 percentage points and matches HIQL without a learned value function. On LIBERO, our ~1B model outperforms WorldVLA (~7B) and the robot-pretrained OpenVLA (~7B), while matching OpenVLA-OFT when both are trained without large-scale robot pretraining. Code and checkpoints will be released.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SplatWAM：分词器把可变数量的无位姿视图编码为固定预算的 3D 高斯 token，动力学模型按动作单次前向预测未来高斯状态，并以对数欧氏协方差与可微渲染监督，另配轻量 flow-matching 策略头。
AI.relevance_reason: 以高斯 token 作为显式三维几何 latent 状态并用渲染做监督，可供核查 LVR 内部状态是否保留几何与任务必要信息、以及单步状态更新的表示选择，但属机器人世界模型，可能需较多迁移核查。
